Furthermore, I require the associated data from both Column B and C on sheet 2. The spreadsheet with an example has been provided. Could you assist me in accomplishing this?", "spreadsheet_path": "spreadsheet/12864", "instruction_type": "Cell-Level Manipulation", "answer_position": "'Sheet2'!B2:B12"}, "rollout": {"task_id": "12864", "output": "import pandas as pd

# Load the spreadsheet
file_path = '/mnt/data/spreadsheet/12864/1_12864_init.xlsx'
xls = pd.ExcelFile(file_path)

# Read the sheets
df1 = pd.read_excel(xls, 'Sheet1')
df2 = pd.read_excel(xls, 'Sheet2')

# Sheet1 columns: Count, Deal Name, Type, Existing Data Fields
# Sheet2 columns: Existing Data Fields, deal name

# Create a mapping from 'Existing Data Fields' to 'Deal Name' from Sheet1
# We use the first occurrence to mimic INDEX/MATCH behavior
mapping = df1.drop_duplicates('Existing Data Fields').set_index('Existing Data Fields')['Deal Name'].to_dict()

# Map the values to Sheet2's 'deal name' column
# Sheet2 Col A is 'Existing Data Fields', Col B is 'deal name'
df2['deal name'] = df2['Existing Data Fields'].map(mapping)

# Save the modified spreadsheet
output_path = '/mnt/data/outputs/12864_0_64250927/1_12864_output.xlsx'
with pd.ExcelWriter(output_path, engine='openpyxl') as writer:
    # We need to preserve Sheet1 as well
    df1.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Sheet1', index=False)
    df2.to_excel(writer, sheet_name='Sheet2', index=False)

# Verification of the target range 'Sheet2'!B2:B12
# In pandas, df2['deal name'] corresponds to Column B.
